title: Curious Urgency 49
author: bpatrick
html: You guys are the best. I wish I had time to respond to comments more often. Just know that I appreciate every one (more than Jonny Paycheck does!) I’ve got week left before I bail on my second master’s and knuckle down to some comics for a few weeks. ‘Til then, here’s some Curious.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Another master’s? I’m giving you all my good karma for this week, so just relax and let the good times roll. I’ll appreciate the comments in your absence.

comments.author: Jamie
comments.html: Loved the touch with the window, really nice work man, really nice. (I could just be insane though)
